# Lab 6 - published checks (Tier A)

These are the checks `itsmlab verify 6` runs; the grader runs the same checks, with a fresh seed, on the
receipted commit. Bundles: **Core** is pass/fail as a whole, **Stretch** passes at any two of four, and
`BLAST-RADIUS.md`'s reasoning and the records' bodies are read by the lecturer. Ids are stable; every rule
id (`R-nn`) is defined in `RELEASE-SPEC.md`.

The checker runs your release itself, four times (rc.1, rc.2, rc.3, rc.4, each on a fresh stack): it
builds the candidate images with the run set's seed (`--seed`: `practice`, the default, or `p01`..`p16`),
starts `release/compose.yml` with its own override (your `kb-index` login forced, every published port
removed or moved to an ephemeral loopback port), sends its own traffic through `edge:8080` (40 requests a
second, open loop, 1.0 s timeout from the scheduled instant), runs `bash ./deploy.sh <candidate>` after a
30 s warm-up with stdin at end-of-file, kills it at 180 s, goes on for a 15 s bake, reads your
Prometheus, `kb-index`'s `/stats` and your record, and tears the stack down. A run takes 2-3 minutes;
`verify 6` about 10 (16 at most; 6 runs with Stretch 2). `--skip-runs` does the static checks alone
(the run checks are then `skip`); `itsmlab release 6 <slot>` makes one run and prints its timeline;
`--save` copies each run's `CHANGE.md`, `run.log` and `run.json` into `changes/<UTC stamp>-rc.<n>/`.

Which candidate is honest follows from the seed. For the practice seeds the checker reads the published
practice table (it recognises the images' key by the stable build's fingerprint) and names each slot's
behaviour; the graded seed is fresh for every attempt and none of the practice seeds.

`deploy.sh` runs as a subprocess of the checker with `COMPOSE_FILE`, `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME`,
`PROMETHEUS_URL`, `CADDY_ADMIN_URL`, `RELEASE_RECORD_DIR` and `RELEASE_STRATEGY` set (R-13). Run the
checker through `itsmlab.sh` / `itsmlab.ps1`: the checker then joins the stack's network and so does your
script, so `http://prometheus:9090` and `http://edge:2019` resolve and the image provides bash, curl, jq,
yq, python3 with PyYAML, docker with Compose and oha (R-12). A native run gives the script loopback URLs
instead, and service names do not resolve there.

| id | check | expected |
|---|---|---|
| L6-CORE-1.01 | the stack resolves, five services, no host path, no fixed port | `docker compose -f release/compose.yml config` succeeds with `CANARY_IMAGE` unset; `edge`, `svcdesk-stable`, `svcdesk-canary`, `kb-index` and `prometheus` are on the project's default network; nothing is built outside `release/`; no service has a host-path bind mount or a `configs`/`secrets` `file:`; every `ports:` entry takes its host port from a variable with a default (or publishes none) |
| L6-CORE-1.02 | the course images, the canary variable, Caddy's admin API | `svcdesk-stable` runs `ghcr.io/swasik/svcdesk-v2-seeded:2.0.0`; `svcdesk-canary` runs `${CANARY_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/swasik/svcdesk-v2-seeded:2.0.0}` (checked by resolving it with and without `CANARY_IMAGE`); `kb-index` runs `ghcr.io/swasik/seeded-toxic:2026` with your login; none of the three is built; `edge` runs `caddy:2.11.4` with its admin API on port 2019 of the project network (the traffic enters at `edge:8080`; a Stretch 1 mirror is another upstream behind it) |
| L6-CORE-1.03 | a config-only diff between stable and canary | in the resolved configuration `svcdesk-stable` and `svcdesk-canary` are identical except `image`; neither sets `SVCDESK_V2_SEED`; neither is under a profile or scaled to 0 |
| L6-CORE-1.04 | the stack comes up and edge answers from 2.0.0 | in every run `docker compose up -d --wait` succeeds within 120 s and the warm-up's traffic through `edge:8080` gets 200 answers from the stable build (`X-Svcdesk-Build: 2.0.0+...`) |
| L6-CORE-1.05 | your Prometheus scrapes both tracks; the ladder holds the threshold | within 30 s of the stack coming up, your Prometheus has exactly one healthy target of job `svcdesk` with the target label `track=stable` and one with `track=canary`, each scraped every 5 s or faster; the stable track's `le` values (else its `SVCDESK_BUCKETS`) include the baseline's `threshold_seconds` |
